# Vocabulary: player_interface

How the player touches this mechanic.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `direct-manipulation` | Direct manipulation | Moves, grabs, or acts on objects directly. |
| `placement` | Placement | Places or paints structures or zones. |
| `parameter` | Parameter | Sets numbers, sliders, toggles, priorities. |
| `orders` | Orders | Issues commands or designations. |
| `programming` | Programming | Writes code, circuits, or rules. |
| `observation` | Observation only | Reads or watches; no input. |
| `language` | Language | Free text or speech. |
| `embodied-skill` | Embodied skill | Real-time motor skill with controller, stick, or body. |
| `choice-cards` | Choice / cards | Picks among presented discrete options. |
